verses.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.
verses.title: Searching for Hope

verses.text: “How great you are, Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
